scope: Six principal organs, six General Assembly main committees and six selected operational entities. This is a starter catalog, not an exhaustive UN system directory.
affiliation: Lucy has no UN affiliation, mandate or endorsement. Task suggestions and SDG mappings are Lucy editorial proposals, not UN instructions.

institutions.name: General Assembly
institutions.mandate: Universal deliberation and recommendations across the UN agenda.
suggestedTaskTypes: Summarize a published resolution with document symbol and date
Compare country voluntary national review priorities

institutions.name: Security Council
institutions.mandate: Primary responsibility for international peace and security.
suggestedTaskTypes: Summarize published peacebuilding recommendations
Map civilian resilience needs from public reports

institutions.name: Economic and Social Council
institutions.mandate: Coordinates economic, social and environmental policy dialogue and development work.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare development indicators for two countries
Prepare a sourced policy options brief

institutions.name: Trusteeship Council
institutions.mandate: Supervised trust territories; operations suspended on 1 November 1994.
suggestedTaskTypes: Build a historical timeline from official records
Explain historical institutional mandate

institutions.name: International Court of Justice
institutions.mandate: Settles disputes submitted by states and gives opinions requested by authorized bodies.
suggestedTaskTypes: Summarize a public judgment with case citation
Explain institution jurisdiction using official materials

institutions.name: United Nations Secretariat
institutions.mandate: Carries out day-to-day work mandated by UN principal bodies.
suggestedTaskTypes: Locate public reports and document symbols
Build a dated evidence register

institutions.name: First Committee: Disarmament and International Security
institutions.mandate: Examines disarmament and international security agenda items.
suggestedTaskTypes: Summarize a public resolution on confidence building
Map peace education resources

institutions.name: Second Committee: Economic and Financial
institutions.mandate: Examines economic and financial development agenda items.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare LDC trade constraints
Draft a sourced structural transformation brief

institutions.name: Third Committee: Social, Humanitarian and Cultural
institutions.mandate: Examines social, humanitarian and cultural agenda items.
suggestedTaskTypes: Audit accessibility of a public service
Compare inclusive education evidence

institutions.name: Fourth Committee: Special Political and Decolonization
institutions.mandate: Examines special political and decolonization agenda items.
suggestedTaskTypes: Summarize official decolonization documentation
Create a historical source bibliography

institutions.name: Fifth Committee: Administrative and Budgetary
institutions.mandate: Examines administrative and budgetary agenda items.
suggestedTaskTypes: Explain a published budget category
Compare public budget and performance documentation

institutions.name: Sixth Committee: Legal
institutions.mandate: Examines legal questions in the General Assembly agenda.
suggestedTaskTypes: Map published treaty resources
Explain a legal committee report with citations

institutions.name: Food and Agriculture Organization
institutions.mandate: Works toward hunger reduction, food security and sustainable agriculture.
suggestedTaskTypes: Build a crop production baseline with units and year
Compare postharvest loss interventions

institutions.name: United Nations Development Programme
institutions.mandate: Supports poverty reduction, resilience, governance and sustainable development.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare municipal service delivery gaps
Create a public policy implementation options brief

institutions.name: United Nations Environment Programme
institutions.mandate: Supports environmental action on climate change, nature loss, pollution and waste.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare waste management options
Map public ecosystem restoration evidence

institutions.name: World Food Programme
institutions.mandate: Provides emergency food assistance and supports food security and resilience.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare food market monitoring reports
Research smallholder procurement requirements

institutions.name: International Trade Centre
institutions.mandate: Joint UN and WTO agency supporting small businesses to participate in international trade.
suggestedTaskTypes: Compare candidate destination markets for a defined product
Verify published tariffs, origin rules and buyer contact routes

institutions.name: UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
institutions.mandate: Supports developing countries through analysis, technical assistance and trade policy dialogue.
suggestedTaskTypes: Research LDC export diversification
Compare border facilitation and digital trade policy options

frameworks.name: 2030 Agenda and 17 Sustainable Development Goals
frameworks.focus: Use target-level references and national priorities to define research questions; outcome claims require measured evidence.

frameworks.name: Doha Programme of Action for LDCs, 2022–2031
suggestedTaskTypes: Verify current country LDC and graduation status before assessing preferences
Compare a crop value chain and identify processing constraints
Prepare a national export support brief with evidence gaps

dataSources.name: FAOSTAT
dataSources.purpose: Food and agriculture statistics; record dataset, year, country, unit and missing-value flags.

dataSources.name: ITC Market Analysis Tools
dataSources.purpose: Trade statistics, market access, rules of origin and modeled export potential. Access and registration conditions vary by tool; projections are not confirmed buyer demand.

dataSources.name: SDG 17 official targets
dataSources.purpose: Targets 17.11 and 17.12 concern developing-country exports and LDC market access. Preserve original target dates; do not treat expired target dates as new deadlines.

steps.deliverable: Five-year production, yield and export series with source, units, missing years and dates.
Three destination candidates compared by import trend, competition and available logistics; distinguish observed trade from projections.
Dated tariff, preferences, origin rules, SPS, packaging and certification checklist from official authorities.
Verified importer identities, company source URL and public contact route; observed role and contact date; no inferred demand.
Shipment scenario with quantity, Incoterm, transport, storage, loss and compliance costs; label estimates.
Recipient-specific municipality or agriculture ministry draft: evidence, obstacles, options, responsible office, budget assumptions and requested decision.

completionCriteria: Primary sources and dates for material claims
agricultureTradePilot.scaleRule: Generate parameterized research briefs only. Each country-product-market task starts queued or proposed; it becomes completed only after evidence collection and review.
